passages.note: Chaptered text printing the operative statewide rent cap and its exemptions; this page names no voter.

rows.reasoning: Wicks voted Aye on final Assembly concurrence in AB 1482 (2019-2020), a single-subject tenancy bill that adds a statewide cap so that an owner "shall not, over the course of any 12-month period, increase the gross rental rate for a dwelling or a unit more than 5 percent plus the percentage change in the cost of living, or 10 percent, whichever is lower" and adds statewide just-cause eviction protection, while leaving local rent ordinances in place. That is "Strengthen existing rent stabilization and extend coverage to more units": it reaches units no local ordinance covered, and it does not "Maintain current tenant protections". "Expand rent control to cover all rental units communitywide" is excluded by the bill's own text, which exempts "Housing that has been issued a certificate of occupancy within the previous 15 years" and sets the initial rate free for a new tenancy.
